rationale.edition: All 37 changed paths live under web/src/** and scripts/translations/** — no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ directories are touched. The Service Graph feature carries an enterprise gate, but that gate is expressed inside OSS nav code (navGroups.ts uses gate: "enterprise", router.ts checks config.isEnterprise) rather than in any enterprise-owned file, so the change itself is OSS.
rationale.skip: Not skipping: the change is user-facing. There is no tests-added label, no skip comment, and the change is not docs/CI-only — it alters live navigation routes, URL query semantics, the nav flyout, and the Traces page tabs.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change replaces the standalone /traces/service-graph and /traces/services routes with in-page /traces?tab=… tabs (spans/traces/service-graph/services-catalog), swaps the search_mode query param for tab, and reworks the nav flyout highlighting/links — all user-exercisable flows a test should verify, including the OSS fallback that resolves service-graph to spans when not enterprise.
rationale.area: Traces. The bulk of the UI change lives in web/src/plugins/traces/** and web/src/composables/shared/router.ts plus the Traces nav items in web/src/lib/core/Navbar/**; sibling Playwright specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/.
rationale.group: Traces. The ci_matrix_cloud.json matrix already defines a Traces testfolder (actual_folder Traces) whose run_files include service-graph.spec.js, so a new tracesQueryTabs.spec.js belongs in that same shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit specs under web/src (router.spec.ts, useTraces.spec.ts, ONavGroup.spec.ts, navGroups.spec.ts, Index.spec.ts, viewTracesHandoff.spec.ts); none are under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so they do not count as Playwright E2E coverage of the new navigation behavior.
